entities.summary: Fredrik Vogt was a Norwegian engineer and civil servant. In the 1930s he was a professor and rector at the Norwegian Institute of Technology. As the first director general of the Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Agency, he played a central role in developing the hydroelectric power capacity in Norway after the Second World War.
